scope: Independent offline prelaunch review; synthetic mutations only, production configuration unchanged

findings.issue: Protocol edits to return semantics or action clipping can be accepted while the execution plan remains unchanged.
findings.impact: A reviewed protocol revision could be recorded but not implemented. Current candidate values agree with current code.
findings.required_fix: Reject unsupported semantic settings before creating a run or loading assets.

findings.issue: Cached-query reuse accepts a corrupted measured-cost receipt despite expected costs being supplied.
findings.impact: Resume can carry incorrect accounting; the final evaluation loader checks its own receipts but search and collection reuse do not perform the same checks.
findings.required_fix: Validate saved request/key/expected costs and nonnegative integer counters on cached reuse and accounting.
